description: Creates a scene file where none is, saves one, or saves a copy under a new path. A save of a scene open in the editor saves the editor's copy, unsaved changes included. Through the editor when one serves the project; with none, a headless engine runs the editor's own tool and the answer says so under writtenBy, or readBy for a read. That engine runs every script of the file, where the editor runs only tool scripts, so what a script changes as the file loads or as a property is set is put back before anything is saved, and a file where that cannot be done, such as a scene whose script does not compile, is refused and nothing is written. An editor of the project that is running and has not reached this server is waited for rather than written around. Operations: create: a new scene with one root node; save: save the scene as it is in the editor, or as the file loads when the editor does not have it open; from says which; save_as (needs newPath): save a copy under newPath. Default create.

newPath.description: save_as: where the copy goes. Only for op save_as.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

rootNodeName.description: create: the root node name. Default the class name, as the editor names a new root. Only for op create.

rootNodeType.description: create: the root node class. Default Node. Only for op create.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

script.description: create: a script to attach to the root. Only for op create.

name: scene_create
title: Create or save a scene
